test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 25 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper offers 25% discount on all table lamps. He offers a further discount of 8% on the reduced price to those customers who pay cash. What does a customer have to pay in cash for a table lamp of ₹2,500?
solution:
**Given:**

A shopkeeper offers 25% discount on all table lamps. He offers a further discount of 8% 

Marked price = Rs. 2500

**Concept used:**

Final Discount% = (A + B) - (AB/100)

Selling Price = MP(1 - D%)

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Final Discount% = (25 + 8) - [(25 × 8)/100]

⇒ D% = 33 - (200/100)

⇒ D% = 33 - 2 = 31%

Now SP

SP = 2500(1 - 31%)

⇒ SP = 2500(1 - 0.31)

⇒ SP = 2500 × 0.69 = Rs. 1725

**∴ The selling Price of the lamp will be Rs. 1725.**
